name: Anti-Reverse-Engineering Bypass
description: Identification and bypass of anti-reverse-engineering protections in software. Covers packing, obfuscation (control flow flattening, opaque predicates, string encryption), anti-debugging, anti-tampering, VM-based protection, and commercial protectors (Themida, VMProtect, Arxan).

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the purpose and types of anti-RE protections
evidence: Can explain packing, obfuscation, and anti-debugging concepts
Familiar with common packers (UPX) and commercial protectors
Understands why software vendors use anti-RE protections

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Identifies and bypasses basic protections under supervision
evidence: Unpacked UPX and simple custom packers
Identified and bypassed basic anti-debugging checks (IsDebuggerPresent, ptrace)
Decrypted simple string encryption using debugger or scripts
Work reviewed by authorized analyst

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently bypasses common anti-RE protections to enable analysis
evidence: Independently bypassed anti-RE protections on 5+ engagements
Handles multi-layer packing and custom unpacking stubs
Bypasses anti-debugging, anti-VM, and integrity checking mechanisms
Uses Frida and debugger scripts to automate bypass techniques
Passed proficiency assessment on anti-RE bypass

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles commercial protectors and VM-based obfuscation
evidence: Bypasses commercial protectors (Themida, VMProtect, Arxan) for analysis
Devirtualizes VM-protected code to recover original logic
Develops automated deobfuscation tools and scripts
Mentors others on anti-RE bypass methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on anti-RE bypass; develops novel deobfuscation techniques
evidence: Published research on obfuscation analysis or deobfuscation techniques
Developed lab methodology and tooling for anti-RE bypass
Breaks novel protection schemes and VM-based obfuscators
Trains teams on advanced anti-RE bypass techniques

assessment_methods.description: Unpack and deobfuscate a protected binary to recover its original functionality
Given a binary with unknown anti-RE protections, identify the protection scheme and develop a bypass strategy
